name: 76522 · Copperas Cove, TX
findings: ZIP 76522 (Copperas Cove) has 85 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76522 (Copperas Cove) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 76522 (Copperas Cove) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 62% of the typical level).
